tools.name: search_farms
tools.description: Search the Find My Farmer registry of local farms in Canada. Returns farm name, location (city/province), type, and the canonical findmyfarmer.ca page URL. Search matches farm names, stories, and what each farm sells (goods, packages, events).

tools.name: get_farm
tools.description: Fetch one farm's full public profile by its URL slug (the last path segment of a findmyfarmer.ca/farms/... URL, also returned by search_farms). Includes the farm story, contact channels the farmer chose to publish, and how to buy from them. Volume-capped: 50 profiles per caller per UTC day — this re

tools.name: search_farmdex
tools.description: Search the Farmdex — Find My Farmer's agricultural knowledge database of categories, species, and variants (e.g. heritage vegetable varieties, livestock breeds). Useful for resolving what a food product actually is before searching for farms that sell it.

tools.name: list_hubs
tools.description: List Find My Farmer hubs — the named local-food regions (foodsheds) farms dock into. Useful for narrowing a farm search to a place.

tools.name: find_near
tools.description: Farms AND coordination points (farmers' markets, off-farm pickup points, stockists) within a radius of a point or a named place, ordered by distance, optionally filtered by what is sold (species ids or a good slug), a farming practice, a service category, or an event type. tools.name: price_stats
tools.description: Aggregate price statistics (low / median / mean / high, farm + observation counts, as-of dates) for a good, nationally or in one province, from Find My Farmer's price ledger. Every bucket covers at least 3 farms and names none; a single farm's own prices, each dated and cited, come from get_farm.

tools.name: whats_in_season
tools.description: Species in their harvest window in a Canadian province for a given month (default: this month), with how many local published farms list each. Window-based (is the month inside start..end), not peak-based.

tools.name: get_place_catalogue
tools.description: Everything available near a place — every species that published farms serving the place list, in taxonomy shape (category → subcategory → species) with local farm counts — plus the place's Wikidata / GeoNames ids.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: The place graph: countries and provinces/states (no args), one country's provinces (country), or one province's metros (province). Each place carries its slug, centroid, reach, and Wikidata / GeoNames identifiers.

tools.name: get_species
tools.description: One Farmdex species: names, taxonomy, description, its GBIF / Wikidata / ITIS identifiers, and its varieties or breeds. Resolve a food name to a species id first with search_farmdex.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Find My Farmer's definition of a farming practice (rotational grazing, grass-finished, no-till…): the meaning, the nuance, the questions to ask a farmer, FAQs, and how many farms claim it. Returns the term's stable IRI.

tools.name: list_goods
tools.description: The goods Find My Farmer publishes reports and price statistics for — the slugs price_stats and find_near accept, each with the species and practices that define it.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The controlled vocabularies find_near accepts: farming practice ids, service category slugs, event type slugs.

tools.name: best_for
tools.description: The best varieties of a species for a use — "best apple varieties for baking" — ranked from the Farmdex's documented tasting notes and trait spectra (1–5, relative to the species' reference variety). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_farms, get_farm · Private data: get_farm, search_farmdex · Public sink: get_farm.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_farms, get_farm · Private data: get_farm, search_farmdex · Public sink: get_farm

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "price_stats" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Aggregate price statistics (low / median / mean / high, farm + observation counts, as-of dates) for a good, nationally or in one province, from Find My Farmer's price ledger. Every bucket covers at least 3 farms and no price is attributed to a farm — this is the public, unattributable side of the FA" → after: "Aggregate price statistics (low / median / mean / high, farm + observation counts, as-of dates) for a good, nationally or in one province, from Find My Farmer's price ledger. Every bucket covers at least 3 farms and names none; a single farm's own prices, each dated and cited, come from get_farm."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
